During the summer of 1975, the Fredlunds, now of Montana College of Mineral Science & Technology, conducted further work in Tract III and initial work in Tract II which is located generally due west and across Sarpy Creek from Tract III. Thirty-four additional sites in Tract III were found.
24BH1117  Open occupation on a high ridge and a small rock shelter, area about 75 by 20 meters, containing 1 end scrapper and 1 fragment.
24BH1118  Temporary open occupation area, 70 by 70 meters, on a knoll. 1 point and 1 fragment were found.
24BH1119  Open occupation on top of a sandstone out crop, area 60 by 60 meters, contain 1 end scrapper.
24BH1120  Open temporary occupation site, 10 by 10 meters, located between two coulees; con taining only 1 scrapper and a fragment.
24BH1121  Small temporary occupation site, 20 by 50 meters, at tip of a narrow ridge, containing 2 artifacts and 2 fragments.
24BH1122  Temporary occupation area, 15 by 50 meters, on bank of a creek with sparse lithic materials.
24BH1123  Open occupation area, 80 by 80 meters, on two small knolls with sparse lithic materials.
24BH1124  Temporary open occupation area, 10 by 50 meters, on a high bench, with sparse lithic materials.
24BH1125  Small occupation area, 20 by 30 meters, on a small knoll, containing 2 scrappers and 3 fragments.
